name: sre-agent-local-dev
description: Root-level orchestration for running the whole system locally with zero external accounts. Each service still deploys independently with its own package.json — this only wires them together for local development and demoing.

scripts.dev:order-a: cross-env PORT=3001 REPLICA_ID=a node scripts/supervise.js services/order-service
scripts.dev:order-b: cross-env PORT=3011 REPLICA_ID=b node scripts/supervise.js services/order-service
scripts.dev:control-plane: cross-env STORAGE_DRIVER=sqlite BREAK_IT_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=1000 node scripts/supervise.js services/control-plane
scripts.dev:dashboard: cross-env PORT=3006 NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTROL_PLANE_URL=http://localhost:3000 npm run dev --prefix dashboard
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n order-a,order-b,inventory,notification,control-plane,dashboard -c yellow,cyan,green,blue,magenta,white "npm run dev:order-a" "npm run dev:order-b" "npm run dev:inventory" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:control-plane" "npm run dev:dashboard"
